user.title: Connect Kestrel NVR
user.description: Enter the address of your Kestrel recorder. An administrator then has to approve the request in Kestrel.

link.title: Approve in Kestrel
link.description:
Open {url}, sign in as an administrator and approve the request from Home Assistant.

Make sure it shows this code: **{code}**

Then press Submit here.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Kestrel
reauth_confirm.description: Access was revoked in Kestrel or is no longer valid. Submit to start a new request.

error.cannot_connect: Kestrel cannot be reached at this address.
error.not_approved: Not approved yet. Approve the request in Kestrel and submit again.
error.expired: The request had expired. A new one with a new code was created.
error.rate_limited: Too many requests. Please wait a little.

abort.denied: The request was denied in Kestrel.
